info.title: FitOS API
info.description: Deterministic fitness engine API. Every number is computed in packages/core, never by a language model (spec §19.1).

bearerAuth.description: Required on every /v1 route except those marked public (§10).

get.summary: Process liveness only (no database)

post.summary: Exchange a Firebase ID token for an app session
post.description: Idempotent. Creates the user row on first sign-in and returns it on every later call. Identity is taken from the verified Bearer token; the body carries device context only.

delete.summary: Sign out: revoke every refresh token for the caller
delete.description: After this, the client must discard its tokens. Because verification checks revocation, an unexpired ID token issued before this call stops working too.

get.summary: Mess menu providers (VIT Vellore)
A provider's messes, each with how fresh the server's copy of its menu is
A mess menu for a day (default: today, your mess): published, inferred from the cycle, or unavailable
get.description: Served from the server's mirror of MessIT, never live. `resolution` says whether the mess published this date; `mess.freshness` says when the server last fetched it. Each dish carries its stored estimate (a range) or null.

get.summary: What should I eat at this meal? Up to 3 plates from the mess menu, filtered by YOUR diet and allergies (Phase 10)
get.description: Today or tomorrow only (tomorrow is for planning: not loggable). Allergies are a hard filter — only dishes confirmed free pass; severity never relaxes it. Every number is a range from the stored estimates; reasons are codes. An unavailable menu gets no plates; an inferred one is labelled. Nothing is stored.

post.summary: Report a dish's estimate as wrong. Stored as pending; changes nothing until reviewed. Retry-safe (201, then 200)

get.summary: TODAY: up to 4 ranked actions for your local day (Phase 11)
get.description: Decided on the server by the deterministic engine from your plan, logs, targets and body records, in your stored timezone. Each action carries a structured reason (code + values, the source of truth) and deterministic English. An action keeps its id while its content is unchanged; `rank` is the current rank. Actions dismissed today are omitted.

post.summary: Record how you responded to a TODAY action: shown, opened, accepted, dismissed or completed
post.description: Order: an exact replay of a stored `clientEventId` (same action, event and occurredAt) is 200 with the stored event, even after the timing window; the same `clientEventId` for a different action, event or occurredAt is 409. Then: another user's or an unknown action is 404; a new event outside its action's window (5-minute skew, the local day through 03:00 the next, delivered within 7 days) is 422; an impossible transition is 422 (a repeat of an event already recorded is 200 with it); `completed` without evidence on record is 422; otherwise 201.

get.summary: The weekly progress report: sessions, volume per muscle, records, protein days, trend weight (premium, Phase 19)
Progress over 30 or 90 days: trend weight, measurements, records, adherence, consistency (Phase 12)
get.description: Computed on read from your own records in your stored timezone; nothing derived is stored. The trend weight is the headline (EWMA); the weekly rate is null before 10 days of data; every change covers at least 7 days — there is no day-over-day figure. Adherence counts only days with a log.

post.summary: Log a weight for a local day (upsert on date; up to 30 days back, never ahead)
post.description: 201 for a new day, 200 when it replaces that day's reading. Never recalculates the nutrition targets.

post.summary: Log a tape measurement for a local day and site (upsert; up to 30 days back, never ahead)
post.description: 201 for a new day and site, 200 when it replaces that reading.

get.summary: Today's check-in and readiness (Phase 13)
get.description: Readiness (0–100) is computed on read from your check-ins, your training and your food logs, in your stored timezone (§18); it is null until today's check-in exists, and a component without its input adds nothing. Advice only: nothing changes your plan.

post.summary: Check in: sleep, soreness, energy, stress (upsert on date; up to 7 days back, never ahead)
post.description: 201 for a new day, 200 when it replaces that day's check-in (the values sent replace the day's). Every value is optional but at least one is required.

post.description: Planned from your own records in your stored timezone (§21): at most 2 a day, 3 hours apart, outside quiet hours, timed from your habits, every kind switchable. Each item says what cancels it on the phone (`cancelOn`). The words are FITOS templates, never generated. Reports are replay-safe.

get.summary: Whether FITOS AI is set up on this server, and what it never sees

post.summary: Ask FITOS AI; answered from the user's own FITOS data through allowlisted tools (stateless)
A meal in your words → a draft of foods and portions to confirm (Phase 14; nothing is stored)
post.description: Only the text is sent to the model. Each food is matched to the FITOS food database and a portion of its own rows, so the numbers are the database's; a food the database lacks is the model's estimate, kept only within §19.2's bounds. The answer is an AiDraft: requiresConfirmation is always true, and the app logs what the user confirms through POST /nutrition/logs. 503 when AI is switched off or not set up; 429 over the hourly limit.

post.summary: A TODAY action's reason in plainer words — or the engine's own when the rewording adds a number (Phase 14)
